actions.script: if (fresh === 'Y') { emailAccountId = null; emailAddress = null; displayName = null; accountKindEnumId = null; delivery = null } const userName = ec.user.userAccount?.userFullName || '' let kindKey = 'EakExternal' if (accountKindEnumId === 'EakHosted') kindKey = 'EakHosted' else if (accountKindEnumId === 'EakSharedHere' || (accountKindEnumId === 'EakShared' && delivery === 'gateway')) kindKey = 'EakSharedHere' else if (accountKindEnumId === 'EakShared') kindKey = 'EakShared' address = {emailAccountId: emailAccountId || '', emailAddress: emailAddress || '', displayName: displayName || userName, accountKindEnumId: kindKey}

label.text: The address you want to read and send mail from here. Gmail, Outlook.com, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail, your own domain or any provider with IMAP or POP and SMTP. Or an address this business hosts, which the mail gateway delivers.

default-field.title: Your name
default-field.tooltip: As people see it on the mail you send

option.text: Shared: a team address such as sales@ or support@, read from another mail server
Shared, delivered here: a team address the mail gateway delivers, with no mail-server password
Hosted here: an address at a domain this business hosts

label.text: Next looks up the server settings, or goes on without a mail server when the gateway delivers the mail. Nothing is sent or changed yet.
